title: Oppenheimer
lede: Christopher Nolan's film about the father of the atomic bomb, followed from the history people looked up to the books they read.
description: A time-ordered ripple map for Oppenheimer: each step dated and marked by how it was measured.
limits: Wikipedia stands in for all attention and one city's library for borrowing. Timing shows order. It does not prove the event caused each step on its own.
dataline: Wikimedia pageviews (daily), Seattle Public Library checkouts (monthly), New York Times bestseller list
